text:
Predicates:
Allowed(x) ::: Pets are allowed in building x.
DepositRequired(x) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in building x.
EqualDeposit(x) ::: The security deposit in building x is equal to one month's rent.
MoreDeposit(x) ::: The security deposit in building x is more than one month's rent.
Cat(x) ::: x is a cat.
Owns(tom, fluffy) ::: Tom owns cat Fluffy.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: Building x is a managed building.
RentAmount(x, $2000) ::: The monthly rent at building x is $2000.
RentApartment(x, y) ::: Person x will rent an apartment in building y.
MoveInWith(x, y) ::: Person x is allowed to move in with pet y.
MaxDeposit(x, $1500) ::: The security deposit in building x is no more than $1500.
MoreThan($2000, $1500) ::: $2000 is more than $1500.

Premises:
∃x Allowed(x) ∧ ManagedBuilding(x) ::: Pets are allowed in some managed buildings.
∀x (DepositRequired(x) → DepositRequired(x)) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in a managed building.
(EqualDeposit(deposit) ∨ MoreDeposit(deposit)) ::: The security deposit can be either equal to one month's rent or more.
Owns(tom, fluffy) ∧ Cat(fluffy) ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat. Cats are pets.
∀x (Cat(x) → Pet(x)) ::: Cats are pets.
ManagedBuilding(oliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building.
RentAmount(oliveGarden, $2000) ::: The monthly rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
RentApartment(tom, oliveGarden) ↔ (MoveInWith(tom, fluffy) ∧ MaxDeposit(oliveGarden)) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if and only if he is allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500.
MoreThan($2000, $1500) ::: $2000 is more than $1500.

Conclusion:
RentApartment(tom, oliveGarden) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in The Olive Garden.
